!1 Scenarios

|scenario           |Ensure Dpt Run In Ai Mode|params                |
|start              |!-SlimProxy.Process-!                           |
|set working dir    |${TEST_DATA_PATH}                               |
|add environment var|GEMINI_CLI               |value        |1       |
|ensure             |run                      |${DPT_EXE} @params|
|push fixture                                                        |

|scenario           |Reject Dpt Run In Ai Mode|params                |
|start              |!-SlimProxy.Process-!                           |
|set working dir    |${TEST_DATA_PATH}                               |
|add environment var|GEMINI_CLI               |value        |1       |
|reject             |run                      |${DPT_EXE} @params|
|push fixture                                                        |
